description: Government Degree College, Haripur, Nihastha, Raebareli, Uttar Pradesh, was established by the Uttar Pradesh Government in July 2016 under RUSA and offers undergraduate courses in Arts, Science, and Commerce; the official site states permanent affiliation with the University of Lucknow since 2022.

supports: NIRF 2025 Overall participating-institutions table lists Government Degree College, Haripur Nihastha with city RAEBARELI and state Uttar Pradesh.
Uttar Pradesh Higher Education Department directory lists GOVERNMENT DEGREE COLLEGE HARIPUR NIHASTHA and points to http://haripurdegreecollege.org/.

Official homepage identifies Government Degree College, Haripur, Nihastha, Raebareli, Uttar Pradesh, college code RB.73, affiliation to Lucknow University, active 2026-27 admissions, and the Courses Offered link.
Official history page identifies Government Degree College, Haripur Nihastha, Raebareli, its July 2016 establishment by the Uttar Pradesh Government under RUSA, and permanent affiliation since 2022.

Official Courses Offered page lists B.Sc. (Maths Group), B.Sc. (Bio Group), Commerce, and the B.A. subject offerings Hindi Literature, English Literature, Home Science, Political Science, Economics, History, and Psychology.
Official e-content page repeats the B.Sc. Maths/Bio groups, Commerce faculty with B.com I yr, II yr, and III yr, and the listed B.A. subjects.

agent_notes: The official history page states that the institute offers one-year certificate, two-year diploma, and three-year degree courses, but the official catalogue names only the undergraduate offerings; generic certificate and diploma entries are retained exactly from the history wording and require manual review.

The official site advertises admissions for academic session 2026-27, but the linked admission.php page returned HTTP 404 and no official eligibility requirements were found; eligibility is therefore null and mode is marked not_stated.

The official HTTP homepage redirects to https://haripurdegreecollege.org/haripurdegree/. Normal TLS verification first produced the exact managed-proxy self-signed certificate-chain error; curl --insecure was then used only for public GETs to the confirmed NIRF, UPHED, and institution hostnames.
